title: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix graduate living in a Ravnican apartment, traumatized by Duskmourn, who divides herself into doubles to cope with work and her research on a shadow above Arcavios.

entities.name: Apprentice Zimone
entities.description: A double split from the part of Zimone that hates disappointing people, who takes the Omenpath Project apprenticeship.

entities.name: Overachiever Zimone
entities.description: A second double split from the part of Zimone that hopes and drives for excellence, who takes several jobs.

entities.name: Friend Zimone
entities.description: A third double, made as company, who is talkative and giggly, and who proposes a way to duplicate the model.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A dryad friend of Zimone who checks on her, helps her see herself kindly, and helps her trace the duplicated Multiverse.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A theatrical elven prince who survived Duskmourn with Zimone and invites her on an adventure.

entities.name: Niko
entities.description: A Duskmourn survivor who accompanies Zimone to Strixhaven.

entities.name: Abatha
entities.description: Zimone's aesthemancer roommate who complains about the open window.

entities.name: Dean Nev
entities.description: A merfolk dean at Strixhaven who hears the survivors' report but relays that the Firemind does not recommend further study.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon guildmaster who offers Zimone an apprenticeship and does not recommend studying Duskmourn's spread.

entities.name: Chamberlain Maree
entities.description: The author of the formal apprenticeship offer for the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Lumia Voj
entities.description: The figure under whom Zimone would work on transplanar proximate disarticulation.

entities.name: Zarek
entities.description: A guildmaster who recommended Zimone for the program.

entities.name: Riku
entities.description: A mage in a Shandalaran paper who copied himself to learn two fields at once.

entities.name: Dean Kianne
entities.description: A dean who lent Zimone a praestigial book.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: A person Zimone would tell about her find if she were there.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A famous pyromancer planeswalker with red hair and bulky goggles, revealed by the spell as connected to whoever duplicated the Multiverse.

entities.name: Killian
entities.description: Dina's guest or partner who may stay at her place.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon behind the House of Duskmourn, whom Zimone fears.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The haunted plane Zimone survived, whose spread her model tracks.

entities.name: The Shadow Multiverse
entities.description: A solid duplicate of the Multiverse that Zimone's model reveals, mirrored above Arcavios.

entities.name: Zimone's Multiverse Model
entities.description: A three-dimensional illusory predictive spell model of the Multiverse that Zimone built in her bedroom.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university where Zimone studied and later returns to report on Duskmourn.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where Zimone rents a tiny, expensive apartment.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane above which the shadow appears in Zimone's model.

entities.name: The Omenpath Project
entities.description: A Izzet research program studying the Omenpath network that offers Zimone an apprenticeship.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of Zimone's studies.

events.summary: Zimone, struggling after graduation, sits in her bedroom with letters piled by her bed, including one from Tyvar inviting her on an adventure.
events.quote: Zimone stares at them, counting four letters in the stack.

events.summary: Zimone lifts the glamour on her bedroom to reveal her illusory map of the Multiverse and refuses to leave the house.
events.quote: An immense illusory map overtakes the entirety of the tiny space.

events.summary: Zimone notices a shadow above Arcavios in her model that does not look like Duskmourn's spread.
A letter arrives from Niv-Mizzet's office offering Zimone an apprenticeship and demanding a reply within twenty-four hours.
events.quote: The Omenpath Project awaits your response to the offer of apprenticeship.

events.summary: Zimone decides to split herself so she can do both the apprenticeship and her research.
events.quote: But what if … what if she could do both?

events.summary: After hours of failing at a duplication spell, Zimone accidentally divides herself and creates the Apprentice.
events.quote: Her double, dressed in white, wisps of blue magic still encircling her like morning fog, blinks back in surprise.

events.summary: Flashback: after Duskmourn Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Niko and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.
events.quote: After Duskmourn, Zimone returned to Strixhaven.

events.summary: Flashback: Dean Nev says the Firemind does not recommend further study of Duskmourn's spread, and Zimone panics.
events.quote: the Firemind does not recommend pursuing study at the moment.

events.summary: The Apprentice returns from her first weeks of work, and with rent short, Zimone creates a second double, the Overachiever.
events.quote: Zimone seizes the feeling and pulls with her magic

events.summary: Zimone's two doubles irritate her, and she tracks the shadow, learning it is a solid thing mirrored above Arcavios that is not a second Duskmourn.
events.quote: Because the shadow in her model isn't a shadow.

events.summary: Zimone makes a third double, Friend Zimone, for company, who proves insufferable but proposes duplicating the model.
events.quote: Zimone emerges with bags under her eyes and a duplicate in a red sweater behind her.

events.summary: Zimone, with Friend Zimone's help, realizes someone is duplicating the Multiverse.
Zimone panics when her flat grows warm and the window is found closed, then Dina knocks on the door.
events.quote: She half-gasps, half-sobs, and bruises her knuckles diving over the bed to open it again.

events.summary: Zimone rants about Friend Zimone to Dina, who gently points out that the double is Zimone herself.
Zimone realizes she cannot be everything, and decides to just be herself for a while.
events.quote: "I can't be everything. I think I need to just be me for a while."

events.summary: Zimone reintegrates her doubles and resigns from the extra jobs.
events.quote: Their forms turn to vapor, the vapor disappears

events.summary: Zimone shows Dina her model, and they trace the duplicate's caster by spell, which points to Chandra Nalaar.
events.quote: "Oh, damn, she's famous," she says, pointing at the image. "Chandra Nalaar.

events.summary: Zimone closes her window and agrees to take Dina's offer of a place to stay.
events.quote: She walks to the window and closes it.

relations.note: Zimone divided herself to create the Apprentice.
relations.quote: The Apprentice understands, because she was once part of Zimone

relations.note: Zimone divided off the part of herself that hopes and drives for excellence.
relations.quote: The part that hopes, the part that drives for excellence.

relations.note: Zimone made a double to be a friend.
relations.quote: Friend Zimone is a real friend.

relations.note: Dina is Zimone's friend who supports her.
Tyvar writes to Zimone as friend and comforts her.
relations.quote: "Friend Zimone," a voice assures from above, "you are safe."
Her roommate, Abatha, is at the door

relations.note: Zimone is offered an apprenticeship by Niv-Mizzet's office.
relations.quote: The mark on it catches her eye—it is from Niv-Mizzet.
